chunks: What is promised will surely come to pass.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the promised event is a 'real occurrence'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute reality (haqq) of the Hereafter, countering the disbelievers' dismissal of resurrection as mere myth. It highlights that divine promises are not rhetorical devices but inevitable cosmic facts, reinforcing the concept of *al-Haqq* (The Truth) as a core attribute of God in the context of eschatological certainty.
